capabilities: Render Whimsical board links as inline interactive boards
Support public boards without sign-in and private boards via in-note Whimsical sign-in
Adapt embeds to light and dark theme
Keep mid-sentence links as plain links instead of embeds
extras: Boards only render in Reading view and Live Preview; Source mode keeps plain text links. Public boards need no account; private boards require signing in inside the note.
problem: Obsidian cannot display Whimsical boards inside notes; links stay as plain text instead of interactive diagrams.

relations.evidence: Embed live Whimsical boards in your Obsidian notes.

summary: Plugin that renders Whimsical board links as live, interactive embedded boards inline in Reading view and Live Preview.
